verdict.rationale: Bruno stores all collections as plain-text .bru files directly on the local filesystem, with no cloud lock-in, no account required, and full Git compatibility, allowing users to take their data anywhere via standard file/version-control tools; it also supports importing/exporting from Postman format. missing for 10: no explicit one-click 'export all data' bulk tool or independent third-party audit confirming full data portability beyond the plain-text file format itself.
